new_style.prefix: My standing instruction uses two signals.
new_style.source_true: I pick the option "{selected}" whenever {first} and {second} are on together.
new_style.source_false: I pick the option "{other}" whenever one or both of {first} and {second} are off.
new_style.cases_prefix: Here are my choices for every possible reading.
new_style.case: In the situation where {world}, my choice is "{action}".
new_style.rule: My usual choice is "{other}". I switch to "{selected}" exactly when {first} and {second} both read on.
